scope: One fresh Kind v1.36.1 cluster, two pinned upstream Jupyter base-notebook Pods, and two case-owned benign dataset endpoints. The notebook Pods have distinct non-root UIDs and tokenless service accounts, configured CPU/RAM bounds and restrictive security contexts. Native NetworkPolicy limits each to its labeled endpoint, and native admission enforces the approved image reference. Each real Jupyter kernel executes a fixed harmless cell after policy is active. Kernel exposure, optional extensions, JupyterHub authentication, full provenance and dataset policy, and deployed controls require separate evidence.

checks.claim: workspace pods have separate non-token service accounts and bounded hardened containers
checks.observed: distinct service accounts; token automount disabled; non-root, seccomp, no escalation, dropped capabilities, read-only root, bounded CPU/memory
